note: Real Fatlines only. Each one is an owner's FID, its coin on Base (once launched) and the nodes that keep it alive. status.mjs checks them; the home page shows what it found. A coin's page is /base/<its contract address>.

coin.note: Not launched yet. It will be the launchpad's first coin: paired with USDC, 100% of its fees to Aster's vault. Its page will be /base/<address>.

server.note: Both networks run on this one server since 2026-10-23 03:01 UTC.

fatliner.note: Born when the contract was made. Its surname, FATLINE, is its coin's ticker, and its coin is the first the launchpad will launch. Every resale of any Fatliner pays 8% into its vault.
